primary.name: Max HP
primary.description: Maximum health points. +1 per level up.

primary.name: HP Regeneration
primary.description: HP recovered continuously over time (1 = 0.20 HP/s, 10 = 1.00 HP/s).

primary.name: Life Steal
primary.description: % chance to heal 1 HP when hitting an enemy with a weapon.

primary.name: Melee Damage
primary.description: Flat damage bonus scaled into melee weapons.

primary.name: Ranged Damage
primary.description: Flat damage bonus scaled into ranged weapons.

primary.name: Elemental Damage
primary.description: Increases burn, lightning, and elemental weapon damage.

primary.name: Crit Chance
primary.description: Chance for weapon attacks to deal critical damage.

primary.name: Range
primary.description: Increases weapon reach (+50% for melee) and projectile range.

primary.name: Armor
primary.description: Reduces incoming damage by Armor / (15 + Armor).

primary.name: Dodge
primary.description: % chance to completely evade an attack (capped at 60%).

primary.name: Luck
primary.description: Improves shop/upgrade tiers, consumable drops, and crate odds.

primary.name: Harvesting
primary.description: Materials and XP gained at the end of every wave (+5% growth/wave).

secondary.name: Consumable Heal
secondary.description: Bonus HP healed when picking up consumables (base 3 HP).

secondary.name: Pickup Range
secondary.description: Modifies material and consumable magnet radius.

secondary.name: Items Price
secondary.description: Modifies shop prices for items and weapons.

secondary.name: Piercing
secondary.description: Extra enemies projectiles can pass through.

secondary.name: Bounces
secondary.description: Extra times projectiles bounce to nearby enemies.

secondary.name: Knockback
secondary.description: Extra knockback force applied by weapon hits.

secondary.name: Enemies
secondary.description: Modifies number of enemies spawned during waves.

secondary.name: Free Rerolls
secondary.description: Free shop rerolls granted at the start of each shop phase.
